## Recording and observation sources

## Method and evidence

Describe the recording clock, independent location reference and their uncertainty,
inputs, search scope, settings, and how outcomes will be evaluated. If reporting
results, include failures and inconclusive cases as well as successes; distinguish
regional or assisted work from independent end-to-end validation.

## Reproduction and limitations

Include the relevant version, commands or links, and unresolved limitations.
